outcome: constant low concentrations of serum phosphorus
cohort: A 34-year-old female patient diagnosed with amniotic fluid embolism (AFE) who was treated with ECMO, CRRT, and blood component transfusion.
finding: This case highlights that the release of inorganic phosphorus from platelets and plasma into the blood prompts PTH secretion, leading to constant low serum phosphorus concentrations in a patient with AFE.
